name: Zoom Phone
description: Zoom Phone is Zoom's cloud telephony platform for business numbers, calling, routing, queues, voicemail, SMS, and administration.
agentUseSummary: Enter credentials from a customer-owned Server-to-Server OAuth app with one granular Number Management read scope, then let selected agents inspect one bounded page of masked Zoom Phone inventory.

capabilities.label: Read masked number inventory
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded Zoom Phone number state without private assignment, address, or full-number data.

approvalRequired.label: List Zoom Phone numbers
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of masked Zoom Phone number-inventory metadata.

blocked.label: Private number data
blocked.description: Full numbers, raw IDs, assignee names and IDs, extensions, caller-ID and display names, emergency addresses, sites, locations, SIP groups, and carrier details are not returned.

blocked.label: Number changes
blocked.description: Allocation, assignment, deletion, porting, ordering, address, site, caller-ID, capability, and routing changes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Communications data
blocked.description: Call history and logs, recordings, transcripts, voicemail, SMS, contacts, participants, diagnostics, and call control are not exposed.

blocked.label: Raw Zoom API
blocked.description: Arbitrary Zoom paths, products, filters, page tokens, origins, headers, bodies, and raw access tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every organization-wide masked Zoom Phone number-inventory read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected masked inventory reads run without Relay per-action approval while the fixed Zoom origins, product filter, bound, redaction, audit, scope, account roles, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware masked Zoom Phone inventory tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware masked Zoom Phone inventory tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer administrator must create and activate a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only number_management:read:list_numbers:admin, then supply its account ID, client ID, and client secret through Relay's encrypted connection flow.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure a dedicated customer-owned Zoom app, verify Zoom Phone licensing and the granular scope, store credentials on Railway, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify token renewal and revocation, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Zoom documents GET /v2/number_management/numbers, the granular number_management:read:list_numbers:admin scope, bounded page_size, and number metadata including private assignment, address, site, and location fields that Relay excludes.
Zoom's granular-scope registry maps List phone numbers to number_management:read:list_numbers:admin and separates get, update, delete, allocation, plan, SMS, and routing authorities.
Zoom requires Bearer authentication and recommends Server-to-Server OAuth for backend services operating only on the customer's own account.
Zoom announced May 2026 deprecations for older Phone number endpoints and directs integrations to the replacement Number Management APIs.
